firstTime.heroDescription: Clear your doubts. Straight answers to everything you want to know before you start.
firstTime.q1: I've never trained martial arts before. Will I be lost?
firstTime.a1:
No.
Many people start here from zero.
Classes are in groups, but there's always close guidance.
We explain the basics, correct technique and truly follow up.
firstTime.q2: I haven't exercised in a long time. Will I be able to keep up?
firstTime.a2:
Of course, you go at your own pace.
There's no obligation to keep up with those who've been training for years.
Intensity is adjusted.
The important thing is to start.
firstTime.a3:
Training is technical and supervised.
Intensity comes after control.
And sparring is not mandatory.
Only those who want to participate, when they feel ready.
firstTime.q4: I don't want to compete. I just want to train.
firstTime.a4:
No worries.
Most of our members don't compete.
They come to train, evolve and leave better than they came in.
firstTime.q5: I don't like gyms. I always feel alone.
firstTime.a5:
Here you don't walk in, put on headphones and leave.
You train in a group, with constant guidance.

Over time, you build relationships with those who train beside you.
There's a team atmosphere.
firstTime.a6:
For your first class, just show up with the will to train.
We take care of the rest.

If you continue, we'll choose your equipment together, no rush.
firstTime.a7:
Yes.
You train, shower and carry on with your day.

classes.a1: Our classes are 60 minutes long, including warm-up, main training and final stretches.

enrollment.q1: Is there a contract or commitment?

enrollment.q2: What does the enrollment fee include?
enrollment.a2: Enrollment includes initial physical assessment, welcome kit (t-shirt and wraps), and personalized guidance in the first month.
enrollment.a3: Payment is made online via credit/debit card or MB Way. After payment, you receive email confirmation and can start immediately.
enrollment.a4: Yes, you can pause up to 30 days per year (vacation, injury, etc). Contact us via WhatsApp to activate the pause.

facilities.a3: Monday to Friday 7am to 10pm, Saturdays 9am to 2pm. Check the class schedule on our website.

s1.title: 1. Object
s1.p1: These Terms govern the subscription to the plans offered by Striker's House, including monthly recurring subscriptions, prepaid pass packages and plans paid through external financing.
s1.p2: By subscribing to any plan, the student declares that they have read, understood and accept these Terms.

s2.title: 2. Monthly Plan (Flexible Recurring Subscription)
s2.p1: The Monthly Plan renews automatically every 30 days, counted from the date of the last payment made.

items: The Monthly Plan renews automatically every 30 days, counted from the date of the last payment made.
The amount is automatically debited to the indicated payment method.
The student may request cancellation of the subscription at any time through the system or by written communication to Striker's House.
Cancellation is subject to a mandatory 30-day prior notice period (1 month).
This period starts immediately from the date the cancellation request is made.
During the 30-day notice period, the student maintains full access to classes and remains obligated to pay the full monthly fees under the current plan.
Cancellation only takes effect after the complete end of this 30-day period.
There is no possibility of refund or proportional reduction of the monthly fee during the notice period.
There is no minimum commitment in this plan, other than the notice period mentioned above.
The Monthly Plan may be paused once per year for a maximum of 90 consecutive days, upon written request to the administration.
The plan will be automatically unpaused on the scheduled end date, with no additional payment required for reactivation.
During the pause period, the student does not have access to classes and the subscription term is extended by the corresponding period.

s3.title: 3. Plan Change (Upgrade or Downgrade) – Monthly Subscriptions
s3.p1: The student may request a plan change (upgrade or downgrade) at any time.
items: The new plan conditions take effect immediately upon approval of the change.
The first charge at the new price will occur only on the next renewal date (30 days after the last payment).
It is recommended to make the plan change as close as possible to the end of the current period to avoid mismatches or overlaps in charges.

s4.title: 4. Pass Packages and Package Changes
s4.p1: Pass plans function as prepaid packages for a specific number of classes.

prepaid.title: How it works
items: Pass plans function as prepaid packages for a specific number of classes.

changeRequest.title: Change
items: The student may request a change to their pass plan (upgrade or downgrade) at any time.
The change takes effect immediately upon approval.

upgrade.title: Upgrade (e.g. from 5 to 10 passes)
upgrade.intro: Any remaining passes from the previous plan remain valid and are added to the new package purchased.
items: Example: If the student had 5 remaining passes and upgrades to 10 passes, they will have 15 passes in total.

downgrade.title: Downgrade (e.g. from 10 to 5 passes)
items: Remaining passes from the previous plan are not refunded.
Striker's House may zero the old passes at the time of the change and assign only the new pass balance.

charge.title: Charge
items: The charge for the new pass plan will occur only on the next renewal or payment date.

s5.title: 5. Quarterly Plan (Prepaid with Discount)
items: The Quarterly Plan consists of a closed 3-month consecutive package, paid in full at the time of subscription.
The applied discount reflects the commitment to the entire contracted period.
This plan is non-cancellable, non-pausable and non-refundable.
Access remains valid for 3 consecutive months after activation.
After the 3-month period, the plan does not renew automatically.
s5.p1: The Quarterly Plan is paid in full at the time of subscription and does not renew automatically.

s6.title: 6. Plans Paid with Klarna or External Financing
items: When payment is made through Klarna or another external financing system, Striker's House receives the full amount at the time of subscription.
The financing contract is entered into between the student and the financial entity.
For internal academy purposes, the plan is considered full advance payment.
In these cases, partial cancellation, pausing or proportional refund is not possible.
Any issues related to instalments must be handled directly with the financial entity.

s7.title: 7. Medical Exception
items: In the event of injury or medical condition preventing sports practice, an exceptional freeze may be granted upon presentation of medical proof and written request.
The medical freeze suspends the remaining term of the plan, does not imply refund and resumes after medical authorization.
The final decision rests with the Striker's House administration.

s8.title: 8. Payment Failures
s8.p1: In case of automatic debit failure, new collection attempts may be made and access to classes may be suspended until regularized.
items: In case of automatic debit failure, new collection attempts may be made and access to classes may be suspended until regularized.
Repeated defaults may lead to cancellation of the plan.
s8.p2: Repeated defaults may lead to cancellation of the plan.

s9.title: 9. Price Changes
s9.p1: Striker's House reserves the right to update the prices of the plans.
items: In the case of recurring monthly plans, any change will be communicated at least 30 days in advance.
The student may cancel before the new price comes into effect.

s10.title: 10. Access to Classes
s10.p1: Access to classes is subject to maximum capacity, prior booking (when applicable) and compliance with internal rules.
items: Access is subject to maximum capacity, prior booking (when applicable) and compliance with internal rules.
Striker's House may change class schedules or structure for operational reasons.

s11.title: 11. Class Booking and No-Show Policy
s11.p1: Participation in classes is subject to mandatory prior booking through the Striker's House system.
items: The student must cancel the booking with at least 2 hours' notice before the start of the class. Cancellations made within this timeframe incur no penalty.
In case of no-show without timely cancellation, the student forfeits 1 pass from the purchased package. This rule applies to pass packages and plans with limited access.
Striker's House may limit or suspend future booking access in case of repeated no-shows.

s12.title: 12. Right of Free Resolution (Online Contracting)
s12.p1: If the subscription is made online, the student has 14 days to exercise the right of free resolution, provided the services have not been used.
items: If the subscription is made online, the student has 14 days to exercise the right of free resolution, provided the services have not been used.
If classes have already been attended, the proportional value for the period used may be charged.

items: The student declares that they are fit for sports practice and assumes responsibility for their physical condition.
A prior medical evaluation is recommended.
